verdict.rationale: Skills and plugins are plain file-based folders (SKILL.md, plugin.json) that teams can check into a repository, and Codex discovers them from `.agents/skills` up to the repo root. That makes them versionable and reviewable through ordinary source control, but only by implication; the product ships no version, review, or rollback workflow of its own. For published plugins, MCP server changes are picked up automatically and go live after automated checks, with no documented rollback path. Missing for 10: first-party versioning/history of automations, a user-facing review/diff workflow, a documented rollback mechanism, and hands-on corroboration of repo-based versioning.
